A '''wooden sword''' is the [[Wooden equipment|wooden]] [[Weapons#Sword|sword]], crafted from [[Planks|planks]]. It deals 4 damage at an attack speed of 1.6 and has 200 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/wooden_sword.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which gives the item the stats listed below.

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===

It deals 4 damage with an attack speed of 1.6.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Planks|planks}}. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
